Convert the wire diameter from millimeters to meters: d = 0.001944 m.
Use the wire length L = 0.492 m and resistance R = 11.705 Ω.
Calculate the cross-sectional area using A = πd²/4.
Calculate the electrical resistivity using ρ = R A / L.
Do not use A = πd² for the circular cross-section.
The electrical resistivity is 7.06 × 10⁻⁵ Ω·m.
